Thank you for your time at our last meeting on Nov 5, 2026. As we look ahead to your review due Nov 5, 2027, I wanted to raise one item for a conversation.

You have held-away assets of USD 1,350,000 at Alcott Retirement Services. Your household also includes 2 accounts and a largest holding, Total market ETF (VTI), at 47.2% of AUM. Cash stands at USD 225,800, or 8.7% of AUM.

I would like to discuss how these held-away assets fit alongside your accounts with us. There is no action needed now. If you would like to talk it through, please let me know and we can arrange a review.

Sincerely,
